description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPolicyEventStrategy' that implements event handling strategies related to policies in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a template for handling policy events, updating PolicyBuilder objects with revision and timestamp information, and applying event-specific modifications.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyEventStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class implementing event handling strategies for policies, designed to be extended for specific event types. It manages applying updates to policies and provides hooks for custom event processing.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an event and applies updates to a policy if it is not null; modifies the policy's revision and timestamp.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overloaded method; one version applies the event to the PolicyBuilder after deriving from a Policy, meant to be overridden for specific event handling logic.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Default implementation that returns the PolicyBuilder unchanged; subclasses can override to implement specific logic.
